(2) She transitions to holding up both shoes—one dirty and one clean—to demonstrate a comparison. She stands in the center of the frame, smiling. The on-screen text overlays her chest area. The focus remains sharp on the physical action of cleaning the dirt off the suede material. (5) She reveals the clean shoe with a look of surprise and delight. Comparison text Before and After appears as she holds the pair together. Finally, a separate shot shows an Off-White canvas sneaker being cleaned on a floor, showing effectiveness.
